sentences.text: Camille hésite à entamer son budget de vacances pour ce manteau.
sentences.en: Camille hesitates to dip into her holiday budget for this coat.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 이 코트를 사려고 휴가 예산을 헐까 망설여요.

sentences.text: Lucas a appris le métier comme préparateur auxiliaire avant de passer son diplôme.
sentences.en: Lucas learned the trade as an assistant technician before getting his diploma.
sentences.ko: 루카는 학위를 따기 전에 보조 조제사로 일을 배웠어요.

sentences.text: Pendant les fêtes, le magasin embauche du personnel auxiliaire, comme le cousin de Camille.
sentences.en: During the holidays, the store hires temporary staff, like Camille's cousin.
sentences.ko: 연말에는 백화점이 카미유의 사촌 같은 임시 직원을 뽑아요.

sentences.text: Pour mettre les gouttes, Lucas doit incliner la tête en arrière.
sentences.en: To put the drops in, Lucas has to tilt his head back.
sentences.ko: 안약을 넣으려면 루카는 고개를 뒤로 젖혀야 해요.

sentences.text: Le vendeur montre à Camille comment incliner le dossier du fauteuil.
sentences.en: The salesman shows Camille how to recline the armchair's backrest.
sentences.ko: 판매원은 카미유에게 안락의자 등받이를 젖히는 법을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Lucas aide sa grand-mère à assembler son pilulier de la semaine.
sentences.en: Lucas helps his grandmother put together her pill organiser for the week.
sentences.ko: 루카는 할머니가 일주일 약통을 채우는 걸 도와 드려요.

sentences.text: Camille a passé tout le dimanche à assembler l'étagère achetée au rayon maison.
sentences.en: Camille spent all Sunday assembling the shelf she bought in the home section.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 생활용품 코너에서 산 선반을 조립하느라 일요일을 다 보냈어요.
